overview_description.description: Mach Industries is a defense manufacturing company that develops and produces unmanned aerospace and defense systems, along with the infrastructure required to manufacture them at scale. Its product portfolio includes strike aircraft, long-range munitions, high-altitude platforms, counter-drone systems, and propulsion technologies designed for military applications. The company follows a vertically integrated approach, designing and manufacturing key components and systems in-house to support production, testing, and deployment. Mach Industries also operates a decentralized manufacturing network that supports the production of defense hardware and related components. In addition to developing operational systems, the company provides capabilities in propulsion, energetics, testing, and advanced manufacturing for defense and aerospace applications.

product.name: Viper
product.description: A turbojet-powered vertical-takeoff, one-way attack unmanned aircraft system that can deploy without dedicated launcher infrastructure.

product.name: Strategic Strike
product.description: A vertical-takeoff cruise missile designed to provide maneuver units with long-range precision strike capability and a payload exceeding 10 kilograms.

product.name: Dart
product.description: A low-cost kinetic interceptor system designed to counter Group 1–3 unmanned aircraft and operate against drone swarms at scale.

product.name: Glide
product.description: A munition designed to deliver low-cost precision strikes at extended range.

product.name: Pike
product.description: A long-range, low-cost munition designed for decentralized, modular deployment in large quantities.

product.name: Stratos
product.description: A high-altitude pseudo-satellite designed to deploy communications, sensors, and other mission payloads from the stratosphere.
